w:r.w:t: Complete System Blueprint — Shuruwat Se Aakhir Tak

Ye document college ERP ke Accounts Module ka poora blueprint hai — login se lekar reports tak. Ismein student types (DRCC, Scholarship, Hostel, Bus), batch-wise fee structure, scholarship verification process, daily collection, aur har role ke liye kya dikhega — sab kuch cover kiya gaya hai.

College ERP ka Accounts Module ek centralized digital system hai jo college ke accounts department ka poora kaam — student fee collection, scholarship tracking, hostel/bus charges, aur reports — ek hi jagah par manage karta hai.

Sabse Zaroori Baat — Batch x Department x Semester

Fee teen cheezein milke decide hoti hai: 1. Student ka Batch (konse saal admitted hua) 2. Department (B.Sc, B.Com, B.A etc.) 3. Semester (Sem 1, 2, 3...)
Example: 2023 batch B.Sc Physics Sem 3 ki fee ALAG hogi aur 2025 batch B.Sc Physics Sem 1 ki fee ALAG hogi — dono ek saath system mein chalenge bina kisi confusion ke.

Ye poore module ki neenv hai. Har student ka ek complete profile hoga. Bina sahi student profile ke koi bhi calculation possible nahi.
4.1 Naya Student — Kya Kya Fill Hoga
Full Name, Father's Name, Mother's Name
Aadhar Number (unique identifier — duplicate check hoga)
Department — select karenge (fee auto set hogi)
Roll Number — system generate karega ya manual enter
DRCC — agar haan toh DRCC ID number bhi fill hoga
Hostel: Haan / Nahi — agar haan toh Room Type select karo
Bus: Haan / Nahi — agar haan toh Route select karo
Agar haan — Scholarship Type select karo (NSP / State / DRCC / Other)
Expected Amount (approx — baad mein actual verify hoga)
4.2 Student Save Hone Par Kya Hoga (Auto)

Jaise hi student profile save hogi:
Tuition Fee (Department + Batch + Semester se) + Hostel Fee (agar liya) + Bus Fee (agar liya) - Scholarship Amount (AWAITED — hold mein) = Total Due (semester wise)
Ye calculation automatic hogi — accountant ko manually kuch calculate nahi karna.
Jo purana data registers ya excel mein hai — use ek baar mein system mein laane ke liye ye process follow hogi.
System ek ready-made Excel template dega jisme exact columns honge jo fill karne hain. Koi manual format nahi banana padega.
Accounts wale purana register dekh ke template mein data bharenge. Har student ki ek row hogi. Paid amount bhi semester-wise fill hogi.
File upload hogi — system automatically check karega: duplicate roll number, invalid department, wrong format, missing fields. Errors ki list milegi.
Agar koi error hai toh wahi row highlight hogi. Fix karo aur dobara upload karo.
Sab sahi hone par 'Confirm Import' karoge — poora data system mein aa jayega with complete history.
5.1 Excel Template Mein Kya Columns Honge
System batch + department dekh ke automatically sahi fee structure map karega. Accountant ko fee manually nahi likhni padegi — sirf kitna pay hua wo likhna hai.
Ye accountant ka rozaana ka kaam hai. Jab bhi student fee bharne aaye — ye process follow hogi.
Roll number ya naam se search karo. Student ka poora profile ek second mein aayega.
System dikhayega: Tuition Due, Hostel Due, Bus Due, Scholarship Status — sab alag alag. Total balance clearly dikhega.
Amount, payment mode (Cash/Online/DD/Cheque), transaction ID (online ke liye), date — sab fill karo.
Save karte hi receipt ready hogi — print kar sakte hain ya PDF save kar sakte hain.

Har payment ka record — amount, mode, date, receipt
Kaun, kab, kya kiya — security trail
Sab ka overview — student types, fee formula
College, Dept, Fee, Hostel, Bus, Scholarship master
Har student ka profile — sab kuch yahan
Excel se bulk import — ek baar
Rozaana ka kaam — search, collect, receipt
Poori history ek student ki ek jagah
Accountant, HOD, Principal ke liye alag alag

Ye system ek baar sahi se set ho gaya toh: • Accountant ka manual register khatam • HOD ko khud puchne ki zaroorat nahi — dashboard par dikhega • Scholarship track karna easy hoga — koi confusion nahi • Old data bhi system mein hoga — kabhi bhi nikal sakte hain • Principal ko real-time college ki fee status milegi
